stage1.impression: A strong graphic idea, eight glowing cabinets in a spectrum against a concrete wall above a river, but it reads as a render, not a night photograph. The wall's colour is one smeared rainbow gradient instead of eight light columns. The denoiser has left a watercolour blotchiness on the concrete and the posts. A dead-black curb bar and a dark horizontal stripe cut the frame into bands, and the horns read as murky, soft-edged boxes, with the black one almost lost against the wall.

blocking_9: No denoiser smear: wall concrete and horn posts show crisp micro-detail at 300% crop, no blotchy patches
Eight distinguishable washes: each column clearly brighter and more saturated than the gaps between them, the overlaps blending, not one continuous gradient
Wash colours true to the cabinets: green column reads green (g > r), blue reads blue (b > r), no warm-pink cast across the whole wall
No full-width crushed-black bands: the curb between paving and river and the stripe at woofer height gone or carrying detail
Every horn's silhouette separates from the wall, the Smoke horn included (at least about 10 levels of contrast)
Board-formed concrete reads at monumental scale with real grain, tie holes and form-board edges, not a soft painted texture

defects.what: Wall reads as one continuous rainbow gradient; no individual washes (gap 1060-1090 lum 66 vs neighbouring washes 81/65)
Denoiser watercolour blotches on the concrete; soft, smeared detail
Warm pink cast over the whole upper wall (r68 g47 b45), even above the cool speakers
Green speaker's wash is not green (r82 g56 b52); Ice blue wash neutral (71/69/68)
Dark horizontal stripe at woofer height between the speakers (lum ~48 vs ~100-120 just above); reads as a bench or wall line cutting the composition
Curb front is crushed black across the full width (47.5% crushed, median 3); a graphic bar splitting paving from water
Smoke horn median 15.6 against wall about 21; silhouette almost lost
All horns read murky and soft-edged, no edge definition or specular on the resin
Hairline dark vertical seams between wall panels (step -27 over 0 px) at x about 487 and 955; reads as a CG seam more than a formwork joint
Dark vertical strips at both frame edges
Reflections are smeared vertical bars with denoiser streaking; the frame has three stacked reflection bands (paving, curb, water)
Concrete texture lacks micro-detail at this scale (flat patch lum_range 20.9); reads painted

changes.problem: Denoiser artefacts make the whole frame read as CG: blotchy watercolour patches on the concrete and smeared posts and edges.

evidence.measured: 300% crop shows blotchy patches and smeared post edges; the staged image is 1440x600 against the card's 2880x1200 frame

change.to: at least 1024 samples at full 2880x1200, OIDN with albedo+normal passes and prefilter 'accurate', light-path clamp indirect 10; deliver the full-resolution frame

changes.expected: Concrete grain and board marks stay crisp at 300%; post and horn edges sharp; no blotches

changes.problem: The washes do not form columns: the wall stands too far back, so every cabinet's light spreads over the whole wall and the colours mix into one gradient.

evidence.measured: gap between Haze and Fog lum_median 66 vs washes 81 and 65; x-profile y120-200 is a smooth 46-85 ramp with no peaks

change.setting: set.props.8 to set.props.24 position y (wall piers)
change.to: 0.55 (face at y 0.40, about 0.18 m behind the cabinets' backs); move set.props.0 to y 1.15 to match

changes.expected: Eight distinct tall columns, each about 1.3-1.6x brighter than the gaps between them, blending only at their edges; the Haze/Fog gap [1060,60,1090,200] falls from about 66 to below 55 while the Haze column [935,30,1015,230] stays at 80 or more

changes.problem: A dark horizontal stripe runs behind the speakers at woofer height and cuts the composition in two.

evidence.measured: lum_median 48.4, against about 100-120 just above (y-profile 93/103/120/99 then 54/59/35/30)

changes.problem: The curb between the paving and the river renders as a full-width crushed-black bar.

changes.problem: The horns get no light of their own: the Smoke horn melts into the wall and every horn reads murky.

evidence.measured: Smoke horn lum_median 15.6, lum_range 5.0; wall beside it [1370,260,1420,300] lum_median 21.1

change.to: irradiance 0.30, position [4, -2, 9] (higher and more overhead) so it rakes the horns' tops and edges

changes.expected: A cool top edge on each horn, the Smoke horn's silhouette readable; the wall above stays dark

changes.problem: The concrete lacks micro-detail and reads painted, not monumental board-formed concrete.

evidence.measured: lum_range 20.9 in a flat patch; 300% crop soft, tie holes faint

change.to: the same scan at 8k (or a sharper board-formed scan with clear tie holes), bump 3.5, vary 0.6

changes.expected: Visible aggregate, board grain and tie holes catching the grazing uplight

changes.problem: The 12 mm gaps between wall panels render as hard 1 px black seams and dark strips at the frame edges, which read as CG joins.

evidence.measured: edge step -27.2, width 0 px; edges [0,0,18,450] lum_median 39.6 and [1424,0,1440,450] 29.1

change.to: 3.596 (4 mm gap), with a chamfered joint, so it reads as a formwork joint

changes.expected: Joints read as faint form lines, no hard black hairlines

out_of_scope.request: More light and edge definition inside the horns (they read as dark, murky resin)
out_of_scope.why: The horn's shape and tint are fixed by acoustic simulation and the product's colours; only the light falling on them can change (c6)
All eight must stand whole in one row across the frame, which already spans about 90% of its width; their scale is set by the shot's purpose
